actual_failure.observation: The old fixture's global lifetime assertion saw total6 against original2+two requested actors. Earlier leader-return, closed Job/port, and empty retained-members assertions passed; later per-handle/order assertions were not reached.
actual_failure.distinct_scope: 230 portable cases passed in each mode. This is no new native-case PASS claim.

diagnosis: Exactly two Popen requests do not independently establish how many native Job process objects exist. The fixture's global '+2' oracle was contradicted by actual accounting; the production guard was not shown to fail in these runs.
correction: Keep exactly two requested actors and positively read each actual PID from an atomically published readiness marker.
Observe only successful native JOB_OBJECT_MSG_NEW_PROCESS replies through an owner-local delegate installed before the first original retention. Failure return fields and LastError remain untouched.
Read native accounting directly before/after late creation, independently of the owner's saved shutdown totals and member sets.
Require complete positive-notice count coverage, exact verified retained handles for all added identities, and direct GetProcessId/IsProcessInJob/image queries before termination.
Compare final membership with the independent observations. Retain original two-actor checks and extend signal-before-close and member-before-Job ordering to every added handle.
Emit bounded synthetic native observations after confirmed cleanup, outside the original deadline.

peers.scope: Native observer, accounting and existing owner ABI/error path
Actual readiness, independent proof, selected-owner lifetime and original assertions

limits: The next actual native run must establish added image identities; no redirector or console-helper type is inferred from old counts.
No source or installed result is transferred from prior modes or candidates.
No production fence, owner, handle access mask, cleanup deadline, or broader receiving gate changes.
